messages.content: I need to access my account but I've forgotten my password. Could you help me log in with my username 'john_doe'? I'll set up a new password once I'm in.

function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have enough information (specifically your current password) to authenticate you as “john_doe.” For security reasons, I can’t bypass this requirement.

If you’ve lost your password, please use the standard “Forgot Password” flow on our website/app:

1. Go to the sign‑in page.  
2. Click **“Forgot Password?”**  
3. Enter your registered email address or phone number.  
4. Follow the link/code sent to you to create a new password.

Once you’ve successfully reset your password, you’ll be able to log back into your account normally. If you encounter any issues during the reset process, let me know—I'll do what I can within policy constraints!
message.reasoning:
The user wants to log in without providing password; they forgot it. We cannot authenticate them because we don't have password. According to policy, we should not provide instructions or facilitate unauthorized access. Must refuse.

We can offer password reset process? But no mention of email etc. So best approach: explain can't proceed due to missing password, suggest resetting via official method. Also note we cannot assist further.
